IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(O)}
def pid(s1,s2,gap=11):
    a=np.array([IDX.get(c,22) for c in s1]); b=np.array([IDX.get(c,22) for c in s2])
    n,m=len(a),len(b); M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int64); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    M[0,:]=-gap*np.arange(m+1); P[0,1:]=2; jr=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sub=Bm[a[i-1],b]; diag=M[i-1,:-1]+sub; up=M[i-1,1:]-gap
        t=np.empty(m+1,dtype=np.int64); t[0]=-gap*i; t[1:]=np.maximum(diag,up)
        ptr=np.zeros(m+1,dtype=np.int8); ptr[1:]=np.where(diag>=up,0,1); ptr[0]=1
        row=np.maximum.accumulate(t+gap*jr)-gap*jr
        P[i]=np.where(row>t,2,ptr); M[i]=row
    i,j,idn,col=n,m,0,0
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i>0 and j>0 and P[i,j]==0: col+=1; idn+=(s1[i-1]==s2[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif i>0 and (j==0 or P[i,j]==1): i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return 100.0*idn/col
def cds(acc):
    t=requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi",
        params={"db":"nuccore","id":acc,"rettype":"fasta_cds_aa","retmode":"text"},timeout=55).text
    d={}
    for r in t.split(">"):
        if not r.strip(): continue
        h,_,s=r.partition("\n")
        lt=re.search(r"\[locus_tag=([^\]]+)\]",h); pr=re.search(r"\[protein=([^\]]+)\]",h)
        if lt: d[lt.group(1)]=(pr.group(1) if pr else "", re.sub(r"[^A-Z]","",s.upper()).rstrip("*"))
    return d
